description: This file contains the Hebrew locale configuration for the Moment.js library. It defines locale-specific formats for months, weekdays, date formats, relative time expressions, and meridiem indicators.

methods.name: defineLocale
methods.description: Defines a new locale configuration for Moment.js, specifying locale-specific formats and strings.

methods.name: isPM
methods.description: Determines if the given meridiem string indicates post-meridiem (afternoon/evening).

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Returns the appropriate meridiem string based on the hour and context.
